title: German Mustardy Pecorino Gratin
description: A German-inspired twist on the classic gratin, featuring a rich mustardy sauce and creamy pecorino cheese.

ingredients.name: Gooey Cheese Blend
ingredients.notes: Combining grated pecorino and american cheese for a creamy, melty topping

instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the Mustardy Sauce and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly thickened.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes. Top with a spoonful of the Mustardy Sauce and a sprinkle of the Gooey Cheese Blend.
Repeat the layering process two more times, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional Gooey Cheese Blend, if desired.
